summary: Build a credible climate transition plan with baselines, targets, risk registers, and reporting tools. Join the course and apply it at work.
lede: Climate transition planning helps sustainability, emissions, operations, procurement, and finance professionals turn climate goals into an actionable roadmap. Participants learn to set Scope 1 and Scope 2 baselines, assess climate risks, compare decarbonisation levers, sequence actions and milestones, and assign governance owners; they also practise creating KPI dashboards and transition reporting materials.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch emissions, reporting, operations, or sustainability planning and need to turn that work into a structured climate transition plan. Sustainability Managers responsible for transition roadmap development. ESG Reporting Leads preparing climate disclosures and KPI narratives. Carbon Accounting Specialists building Scope 1 and Scope 2 baselines. Energy and Facilities Managers identifying operational decarbonisation levers. Procurement Managers integrating supplier emissions inputs into planning. Finance Business Partners linking climate actions to budgets and capital plans. Operations Managers coordinating implementation across sites and functions. Climate Risk Analysts assessing transition and physical risk exposure. Corporate Affairs Leads communicating transition progress to stakeholders. Sustainability Consultants supporting client transition plan design.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and the ability to work with sample emissions or activity data. If possible, bring a recent sustainability report, emissions summary, or internal KPI pack so you can adapt the exercises to your own context.
